scenes.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE standalone high-budget live-action SCIENCE FICTION COMEDY film still, 16:9 landscape, cinematic theatrical realism. NOT a clean commercial office stock photo. Original fictional Korean adult male office employee A, about 35, natural short side-parted black hair, ordinary light beige long-sleeve button shirt, charcoal-gray trousers, plain dark shoes, holding an unbranded white ceramic coffee mug. Original actor, not a celebrity.
SCENE: a plain contemporary office beside a huge glass window at dusk. Outside, a truly COLOSSAL original dark metallic alien spacecraft underside obscures nearly the whole sky, its brutal-scale curved structural ribs and cold blue running lights visible beyond the glass. A narrow vertical blue-white volumetric tractor beam enters through the ceiling/window area and surrounds ONLY the man. His whole body is floating about 20cm above the office floor, with a clear visible gap under BOTH shoes and a soft shadow below. He stands upright in the beam, looks down calmly at his coffee, carefully cups the mug so it will not spill. His expression is a small baffled inconvenience, not terror, not screaming; that mundane priority is the absurd joke. Ordinary papers, desks, chairs and objects remain solidly on the ground. No other people.
Wide, slightly low camera that shows A's full body, face, mug, floor gap and massive spacecraft outside. A centered slightly to the right with cinematic environment depth. Cold blue shaft light and hard rim highlights cut through atmospheric haze; desaturated ordinary office, dramatic shadows, detailed real skin and beige fabric. Monumental invasion film lighting contrasted against a man's humble coffee concern. Filmic lens, subtle grain, credible practical set, not cartoon or glossy game render. Entire single frame. No weapons, injuries, restraint, extra floating objects, existing sci-fi franchise designs, captions, text, numbers, logos, brand names or watermarks.
scenes.motion: 그림자가 지나간 뒤 빛기둥이 A만 감싼다. A가 머그잔을 조금 들어 내용물이 흐르지 않게 하면서 위로 이동한다. 과잉 액션 대신 거대 상황과 소박한 행동의 대비를 둔다.

scenes.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT this sci-fi comedy frame with a targeted ANATOMY/POSE CORRECTION on ONLY THE CENTRAL PURPLE-UNIFORM ALIEN B. Preserve the same exact head/face design and panicked expression, plum outfit, overhead scanner, giant food hologram, human at left, two-armed assistant at right, camera, room and cinematic lighting.
The central alien intentionally has FOUR arms and four hands. DO NOT reduce him to a human two-arm body. Turn his torso somewhat toward camera into a three-quarter front view so all four arm origins and ALL FOUR HANDS are clearly visible while he tries frantically to cover the big food screen. TWO upper arms attach at shoulders, TWO lower arms attach symmetrically at left/right upper ribcage beneath the upper shoulders. Show a separate purple sleeve at each of these FOUR joints. Each arm has one elbow, one wrist and one hand, not branching arms. Fan the arms to upper-left, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right at distinct heights like a desperate attempt to block a big screen. Slight overlap with the food display is good; no arm hides entirely behind his back. The head still looks alarmed toward assistant.
CRITICAL HAND DETAIL: every one of B's FOUR hands has exactly FOUR DIGITS TOTAL: ONE thumb plus THREE elongated fingers. Not four fingers plus thumb, not five or six fingers. Make the separated digits simple, broad and clearly countable. Maintain the character's single head, one torso and two legs. Preserve the food plate behind him visible between his arms. No change to other characters. No words, logos or watermark.

Same curved structural ribs, window into massive ship exterior, reflective gunmetal floor. Warm white teaching lights have just switched on, MIXED with remaining cold blue rim lights, atmosphere and theatrical depth; retain high-budget alien setting, not an ordinary office or school classroom. Do not copy a famous alien IP. No lettering, numbers, logos, captions, recognizable software or watermarks.
STORY MOMENT: Commander B is now an overwhelmed, desperately eager student whose OWN FOUR ARMS are working against each other. NOT all arms raised. Compose him prominently center-right at a simple gunmetal student desk, front three-quarter view with ONE TORSO and ALL FOUR distinct arm attachments visible above desk level. Exactly FOUR ARMS: UPPER LEFT arm is trying to raise its hand to ask a question, elbow bent, forearm diagonally upward; UPPER RIGHT arm crosses over and visibly GRIPS THAT RAISED LEFT WRIST, PULLING IT BACK DOWN. The left hand is still partly raised while the right hand stops it: this physical wrist-grab must be immediately readable, not a high-five or hands fused together. LOWER LEFT arm holds an open plain notebook flat on his desk; LOWER RIGHT hand frantically WRITES with a single pen on it. These lower arms emerge from separate lower ribcage sleeves, not from the upper arms. Keep all four limb paths distinct with clear shoulders/elbows/wrists.
